newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Supreme Court asked to halt NationsBank.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Supreme Court asked to halt NationsBank.

text.p: A New Mexico based community group that objects to NationsBank Corp's $9.8 billion acquisition of Boatmen's Bancshares Inc on Monday asked the U.S. Supreme Court to grant an emergency order to halt the purchase, an attorney for the group said.

On Friday, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 10th circuit in Denver denied a stay requested by InnerCity Press/Community on the Move and the New Mexico Alliance to stop the acquisition. The groups argue that the acquisition will result in bank closings and higher ATM fees and therefore be detrimental.
Boatmen's has a banking unit in New Mexico.
The transaction is expected to close on Tuesday.
